title: Leaving with unsaved changes asks, leaving with none does not
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  5. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  6. Click Edit.
  7. Type 60 in Default's first range.
  8. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  9. Click Keep Editing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit with no changes.

Step 4:

  • The Matrices list shows at once.
  • No question was asked.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 6:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 7:

  • Default's first range reads 60.

Step 8:

  • A question "Discard These Changes?" opens with Keep Editing and Discard Changes.

Step 9:

  • The question closes.
  • The grid is still in edit with 60.
